responsibility: Implements the main GCC language hook bridge for the COBOL front end executable cobol1. It defines the required lang_type/lang_decl/lang_identifier/GTY scaffolding for GCC garbage collection, initializes COBOL-specific builtin types and constants, provides hooks for option handling, parsing, type selection, builtin registration, assembler-name mangling of COBOL identifiers, and SARIF language naming, thereby connecting gcc/cobol parsing and GENERIC generation to GCC’s front-end framework.
